name: Feira de Antiguidades e Velharias
description: The Feira de Antiguidades e Velharias is a market organized by the Municipality of Porto. It takes place on the third Saturday of each month, offering a variety of antique and rare items.
longDescription:
The Feira de Antiguidades e Velharias is held on the third Saturday of every month at Praça Francisco Sá Carneiro, also known as Praça Velásquez. The market runs from 08:00 to 18:00.

Visitors can find a range of old and rare objects, including books, porcelain, furniture, decorative items, coins, jewelry, tapestries, and paintings. The event is organized by the Municipality of Porto and admission is free.

longDescriptionPt:

Os visitantes podem encontrar uma série de objetos antigos e raros, incluindo livros, porcelanas, mobiliário, artigos de decoração, moedas, joias, tapeçarias e pinturas. O evento é organizado pela Câmara Municipal do Porto e a entrada é livre.
